name: Magmin
summary: A small elemental of fire whose touch sets things burning.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.text: The magmin explodes when it dies. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* {dc:con}, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the magmin. *Failure*: {dmg:2d6:fire}. *Success:* Half damage.

actions.name: Touch
actions.onHit: If the target is a creature or a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it starts burning.

bonusActions.name: Ignited Illumination
bonusActions.text: The magmin sets itself ablaze or extinguishes its flames. While ablaze, the magmin sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.
